usage: Used as the first-person singular pronoun meaning "I" or "me"
Commonly placed before verbs, adjectives, or sentence-final particles in spoken Cantonese
Often appears in everyday expressions to describe feelings, intentions, or opinions
examples: 我今日要返工，所以唔得閒
我覺得呢間餐廳啲嘢好好食
如果你有時間，可以搵我一齊去
我之前去過香港好多次
其實我都唔係好清楚點做
我本來想去，但最後冇去到
